summary: Remove-attachment button on file thumbnails has poor contrast and inconsistent positioning
description:
Steps to Reproduce
Open a form containing a file/image attachment field.
Clinical form → Test form 2 → Body Conditions section → file attachment component


Attach one or more image files with a white background and with different colours.

Observe the remove ("X") button on each thumbnail.

Current Behaviour
The remove button's icon has a white no border or backgroud drop shadow behind it. When the attached image has a light or white background near the top-right corner, the button becomes nearly invisible.

The thumbnail container is missing position: relative, so it is absolutely positioned. removeButton isn't consistently anchored to that thumbnail's top-right corner — it appears misaligned relative to different thumbnails.

Expected Behaviour
The remove button should stay clearly visible regardless of the underlying image.

The button should be consistently anchored to the top-right corner of every thumbnail.
